integrity: The proof separates the new realization input from direct Banach-algebra and unilateral-shift calculations. No finite computation is promoted to an infinite proof, and no claim of independent validation or priority is made.
scientific_limitations: The construction gives one explicit spectral boundary for the finite-detector realization. It does not characterize which additional hypotheses make spectra recoverable from finite stages. The disk-algebra finite-section mechanism itself is classical; the checked novelty is its exact consequence inside the 2026 Calkin realization.
title: Nilpotent finite detectors with full disk essential spectrum
